commands: cd /workspace/alchemy && alchemy state list | grep -i subnet
cd /workspace/alchemy && alchemy state list | grep -i "networkinterface\|eni"
cd /workspace/alchemy && alchemy state list | wc -l
cd /workspace/alchemy && alchemy state list | head -30

cd /workspace/alchemy && for subnet in exp-DefaultPublicSubnetId1 exp-DefaultPublicSubnetId2 exp-NUMSubnets exp-PublicSubnetId usw1-exp-PublicSubnetId usw2-exp-PublicSubnetId; do echo "=== $subnet ===" alchemy state get alchemy-ec2-multiregion/bench/$subnet | jq '.output' done
cd /workspace/alchemy && alchemy state list | grep -E "(Instance|Instance|ENI|network)" | head -20
cd /workspace/alchemy && alchemy state get alchemy-ec2-multiregion/bench/public | jq '.output'
cd /workspace/alchemy && alchemy state get alchemy-ec2-multiregion/bench/private | jq '.output'
cd /workspace/alchemy && alchemy state get alchemy-ec2-multiregion/bench/usw1-public | jq '.output'
cd /workspace/alchemy && alchemy state get alchemy-ec2-multiregion/bench/usw2-public | jq '.output'
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region us-east-1 --query 'NetworkInterfaces[*].[NetworkInterfaceId,SubnetId]' --output table
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region us-west-1 --query 'NetworkInterfaces[*].[NetworkInterfaceId,SubnetId]' --output table
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region us-west-2 --query 'NetworkInterfaces[*].[NetworkInterfaceId,SubnetId]' --output table
aws ec2 describe-regions --query 'Regions[*].RegionName' --output text | tr '\t' '\n'

for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "=== Subnets in $region ===" aws ec2 describe-subnets --region $region --query 'Subnets[*].[SubnetId,Tags[?Key==`Name`].Value|[0]]' --output table done

for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "=== Network Interfaces in $region ===" aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region $region --query 'NetworkInterfaces[*].[SubnetId]' --output text | sort | uniq done
